nml_option.name: config_use_sedimentTracers
nml_option.description: if true, the sedimentTracers category is enabled for the run

nml_option.name: config_sediment_tracer_count
nml_option.description: Number of active sediment size classes (1 to 3)

nml_option.name: config_sediment_sinking_rate_1
nml_option.description: Sinking rate for sediment class 1 (unaggregated mud)

nml_option.name: config_sediment_sinking_rate_2
nml_option.description: Sinking rate for sediment class 2 (aggregated mud)

nml_option.name: config_sediment_sinking_rate_3
nml_option.description: Sinking rate for sediment class 3 (very fine sand)

nml_option.name: config_sediment_critical_shear_1
nml_option.description: Critical bed shear stress for erosion of sediment class 1

nml_option.name: config_sediment_critical_shear_2
nml_option.description: Critical bed shear stress for erosion of sediment class 2

nml_option.name: config_sediment_critical_shear_3
nml_option.description: Critical bed shear stress for erosion of sediment class 3

nml_option.name: config_sediment_particle_density
nml_option.description: Particle density (mineral sediment/quartz default)

nml_option.name: config_sediment_erosion_rate
nml_option.description: ERATE: erosion rate constant (CROCO MUSTANG formulation). Setting to 4.0e-5 reproduces toy test.

nml_option.name: config_sediment_bed_porosity
nml_option.description: Porosity of surficial seafloor sediments

nml_option.name: config_river_sediment_load
nml_option.description: River sediment load, based on Arctic rivers

nml_option.name: config_use_sediment_river_flux
nml_option.description: if true, sediment input from river runoff is applied at the surface

nml_option.name: config_use_sediment_sea_ice_coupling
nml_option.description: if true, ice-ocean sediment flux coupling is enabled

nml_option.name: config_use_sedimentTracers_surface_bulk_forcing
nml_option.description: if true, surface bulk forcing from coupler is added to surfaceTracerFlux in sedimentTracers category

nml_option.name: config_use_sedimentTracers_surface_restoring
nml_option.description: if true, surface restoring source is applied to tracers in sedimentTracers category

nml_option.name: config_use_sedimentTracers_interior_restoring
nml_option.description: if true, interior restoring source is applied to tracers in sedimentTracers category

nml_option.name: config_use_sedimentTracers_exponential_decay
nml_option.description: if true, exponential decay source is applied to tracers in sedimentTracers category

nml_option.name: config_use_sedimentTracers_idealAge_forcing
nml_option.description: if true, idealAge forcing source is applied to tracers in sedimentTracers category

nml_option.name: config_use_sedimentTracers_ttd_forcing
nml_option.description: if true, transit time distribution forcing source is applied to tracers in sedimentTracers category

package.name: sedimentTracersPKG
package.description: This package includes variables required to compute bulk restoring on the sedimentTracers group.

package.name: sedimentTracersSurfaceRestoringsPKG
package.description: This package includes variables required to compute surface restoring on the sedimentTracers group.

package.name: sedimentTracersInteriorRestoringPKG
package.description: This package includes variables required to compute interior restoring on the sedimentTracers group.

package.name: sedimentTracersExponentialDecayPKG
package.description: This package includes variables required to compute exponential decay on the sedimentTracers group.

package.name: sedimentTracersIdealAgePKG
package.description: This package includes variables required to compute ideal age forcing on the sedimentTracers group.

package.name: sedimentTracersTTDPKG
package.description: This package includes variables required to compute transit-time distribution forcing on the sedimentTracers group.

var.description: Suspended sediment concentration, size class 2

var.name: sediment1PistonVelocity

var.name: sediment3PistonVelocity

var.name: sediment3SurfaceRestoringValue
var.description: sediment3 is restored toward this field at a rate controlled by sediment3PistonVelocity.
